message:
Bump crate versions to 0.4.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #10 from zeugmaster/feature/console-usability

Console: Keys and Activity tabs, bounded lists, status-first Mint tab

Add Keys and Activity tabs, bound long lists, and lead the Mint tab with status

Keys tab: a timeline of every keyset (issuing, redeem-only, expired, start
unknown) built from a processor-side log of when each keyset was first seen
and stopped issuing, expiry warnings in the checklist, and a copyable
cdk-mint-cli command for rotating to keys with a chosen lifetime. The console
still never manages the mint.

Activity tab: paged settled history with search, kind/status/date filters
and CSV export; tickets now record who settled or voided them. Open quotes
collapse after ten rows, the chart buckets by day with a range selector, and
relative times show the exact time on hover.

Mint tab: one status card (headline, five-step strip, the next step) with the
full checks, self-test, config snippet and protocol facts in collapsible rows.

Also fixes horizontal overflow at phone width across the console.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
